_note: Bestiary (owner, 2026-10-16). Original descriptions written for this fan game. An entry unlocks when its creature is first defeated (flag 'beast:<id>'; ids are enemy/flyer types and boss ids). 'anim' is the portrait (sprite animation key); 'blood' tells how much the Crusnik meter gains: none, thin or rich.

thrall.name: String-bound Thrall
thrall.text: Citizens of Istvan who followed a gentle violin into the night. Silver threads now move their limbs; behind the slack faces, some of them are still awake.
thrall.tip: Slow and honest. Let the claw pass, then answer it. Staggered, they fall to the revolver.

deathHunter.name: Death Hunter
deathHunter.text: Methuselah that died long ago and were raised again by someone patient. Their blood has gone cold and sour, but it is still the blood of the long-lived.
deathHunter.tip: Fast chops with a long reach. Stagger one and drain what little is left.

methuselah.name: Low-born Methuselah
methuselah.text: Servants of the Count's household, alive and hungry, in coats a century out of fashion. They despise the city they once kept, and they do not tire.
methuselah.tip: A crouch, then a lunging claw. Dodge through it. Their blood fills the meter quickly.

boneRat.name: Bone-rat
boneRat.text: Rats that have lived too long among the ossuary dead and taken on their colour. Nobody knows what they eat now.
boneRat.tip: Low to the ground: crouch and strike.

bat.name: Cellar Bat
bat.text: They roost in the shafts and towers by the thousand, and wake all at once when a stranger passes beneath.
bat.tip: They swoop in a straight line. Step aside, then strike as they climb.

fairy.name: Tunnel Fairy
fairy.text: Small, bright, and nothing like the stories. They live where the old water runs, and their scream can crack stone.
fairy.tip: Their scream spreads in rings. Leave the ring, or jump it, then cut them down mid-air.

ironChoir.name: Iron Choir
ironChoir.text: Armour with no one inside, strung on the same silver thread as the thralls and taught to march in step. They sing when they move.
ironChoir.tip: The shield turns blows from the front. Get behind them, or parry the halberd and strike.

inquisitor.name: Inquisition Hunter
inquisitor.text: Rome's own, sent ahead of Brother Petros. They shoot anything unholy, and are not careful about what that includes.
inquisitor.tip: They keep their distance and loose crossbow bolts. Close in. Beaten, they are only knocked out.

imperialGuard.name: Imperial Guard
imperialGuard.text: Methuselah soldiers of the Empress in blue enamel and gold. Proud, patient, and certain that a Terran priest is a spy.
imperialGuard.tip: The shield turns blows from the front. Get behind them, or wait for the spear to pass.

zealot.name: Rosenkreuz Zealot
zealot.text: Humans who serve the Orden for a promise of a world without either Rome or the Empress. They throw fire into crowds.
zealot.tip: They keep their distance. Close in fast; the phase-step passes through their fire.

paula.name: Sister Paula
paula.text: An Inquisition sister with two silver blades and no patience for wandering priests. She was hunting the same thing you were.
paula.tip: Her dash crosses the whole floor. Parry the amber slashes; dodge the red ones.

kampfer.name: The Magus
kampfer.text: A soft-spoken man of the Rosenkreuz Orden who knew Abel's name before they met, and wanted only to see what slept inside him.
kampfer.tip: He vanishes and casts from afar. Chase him down between spells.

marchesa.name: The Marchesa
marchesa.text: A Methuselah noblewoman who once gave the finest balls in Istvan. Someone strung her up and made her dance for him.
marchesa.tip: She leaps, hangs from the chandeliers and dives. Watch where she lands. Her blood feeds the meter.

janissary.name: The Janissary Captain
janissary.text: Captain of the Empress's own guard, two centuries in her service. Honest, stubborn, and very good with a sabre. Someone made sure he would hate Abel.
janissary.tip: Parry the sabre cuts. The shield bash is quick but short. When he glows at the arena's edge, jump the charge.

radu.name: Radu Barvon
radu.text: Ion's oldest friend, a Methuselah noble who never forgave the peace. He grew flame from blood in the dark under the palace, and in the end let it grow into him.
radu.tip: Parry the whip. Jump the flames along the floor. Burning, he marks the floor before each pillar of fire: step off the mark.

flameBeast.name: Grown Flame-beast
flameBeast.text: One of Radu's failed batches: fire grown from Methuselah blood, shaped like the thralls of Istvan and just as hungry. It does not bleed. It only burns.
flameBeast.tip: Hits harder than a thrall. It gives the blood meter nothing: fight it as the priest.

petros.name: Brother Petros
petros.text: The Inquisition's hammer, a knight in white armour who believes every word he says. He came for a monster in a cassock.
petros.tip: Slow wind-ups, heavy charges. Step aside and punish the recovery.

dietrich.name: Dietrich von Lohengrin
dietrich.text: A young man with a choirboy's smile who plays people like strings. First his Grand Marionette of bells and pipes, then the puppeteer himself.
dietrich.tip: Jump the red shockwaves, parry the amber sweeps, and keep moving under the falling threads.

gyula.name: Gyula Kádár
gyula.text: Lord of Istvan, a Methuselah who loved a human woman and watched the city burn her. The Star of Sorrow is his grief made into a weapon.
gyula.tip: Light columns are marked on the floor before they strike. Move. At half health, the wings.

cain.name: Cain
cain.text: The first of them, and the strongest. He wears white and smiles like a saint, and he has waited a very long time for his brother to come home.
cain.tip: Red blasts fly where you stand: move between them. The lance charge cannot be parried. In the sky, keep beating your wings; his dive comes to your height.
